title_sq: SHITET VILE INDIVIDUALE TE SECRET GARDEN!
description_sq:

Ne nje nga rezidencat me te mira te zones se TEG, ofrojme vile individuale 4-kateshe per shitje. 
Me siperfaqe ndertimi prej 294m2, e vendosur ne nje parcele prej 346m2. 
Vila eshte e organizuar si me poshte:
Kati -1: 120 m2, menduar per palester, hobby room, hapesire relaksi (sauna, jacuzzi), tualet, magazine, depo teknike, lavanderi
Kati 0: 98 m2, sallon ndenjie, kuzhine e vecuar, depo, tualet, oborr perreth viles
Kati 1: 98 m2, 3 dhoma gjumi, 3 tualete, 1 verande
Kati 2: 98 m2, 2 dhome gjumi , 1 garderobe, 2 tualet2, 1 verande
Vila eshte ne faze punimesh, duke ofruar mundesine e pershtatjes sipas nevojave te klientit. 
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor sii dhe nje projekt te detajuar arredimi.
Per me shume informacion jeni te lutur te na kontaktoni!
title_en: INDIVIDUAL VILLA FOR SALE IN SECRET GARDEN!
description_en: Individual villas in Secret Garden for sale! In one of the best residences in the TEG area, we offer individual 4-storey villas for sale. With a construction area of ​​294m2, located on a plot of 346m2. The villa is organized as follows: Floor -1: 120 m2, designed for gym, hobby room, relaxation area (sauna, jacuzzi), toilet, warehouse, technical storage, laundry Floor 0: 98 m2, living room, separate kitchen, storage room, toilet, yard around the villa Floor 1: 98 m2, 3 bedrooms, 3 toilets, 1 veranda Floor 2: 98 m2, 2 bedrooms, 1 wardrobe, 2 bathrooms, 1 veranda. The villa is under construction, offering the possibility of adaptation according to the needs of the client. It has regular mortgage documentation and a detailed furnishing project. For more information, please contact us!
